Commentary.Commentary: Hmmm... a required rate of under 10 at the Bull Ring. Good enough for the chasing side or the defending one? We shall find out soon. Australia have not quite embraced the shortest format, especially outside home and this will be a stiff challenge. Stay tuned.

196, did you say? Poor bowling, it must have been. NO. Not entirely. But the fielding was atrocious. They could have easily cut off 20-30 runs off the total had all catches been held or even some of the stops been made. Dale Steyn strut his stuff, having his wood over the Aussies while Tabraiz Shamsi made sure that placards of 'Aussies can't play spin' kept rising in the stands. Their combined figures of 8-0-62-4 pushed Australia back, especially in the middle overs. Ngidi, Rabada and Phehlukwayo were not that consistent enough.

The Aussies started like a train on fire. They lost Warner second ball but then, Finch and Smith launched a counter-attack. Their 80-run association seemed to knock the wind out of the Protea sails but Finch's wicket got South Africa back into the game. The cutters, slower balls, knuckle balls etc... started to do the trick and the visitors started to lose momentum. The middle order could not quite get their timing right and in the end, a cameo from Ashton Agar took them close to the 200-mark.

Well, that is an okayish kind of total by Australia. They were 99/2 in the first 10 and have scored more or less the same in the next 10. It was more of a 'Hit-a-six-or-you-will-be-punished' sort of approach from the Kangaroos and one believes that while it did give them a headstart, they might end up falling 15-20 short.

TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Excellent finish for Australia. 18 runs came from the last over from Rabada. Short delivery from Rabada on off, Agar looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes over de Kock's head. It races to the fence and AUSTRALIA END ON 196/6.
Short ball on middle, Starc looks to pull but it takes the edge, goes onto hit the chest area and the ball rolls to the leg side. A single taken.
Yorker on off, Agar digs it out to point and the batters take a single.

What happened there? Quinton de Kock and Tabraiz Shamsi are in two minds as to who will go for the catch and the ball ends up dropping safely. Short ball on middle, Agar looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes towards short third man. De Kock runs across while Shamsi runs ahead from short third man. Nobody calls for it and eventually the ball lands in between them. South Africa have been very poor in the field and this is another one of those instances. Two taken in the end.
SIX! Hammered! Another full one on off, Agar stands in his crease and thrashes it over the long off region for a biggie. 10 off the first two balls.

FOUR! CREAMED! That is some way to find the gap. Full outside off, Agar leans forward and drives it uppishly. It is slightly wide of mid off and the fielder dives in an attempt to stop the ball but fails to do so. The ball goes through!
Kagiso Rabada is back on. 2-0-27-0 so far.

SIX! Slower delivery does not work this time. It is bowled around off, Starc waits for it and looks to go big. He hits this high in the air, getting seemingly more height than distance but long on is a mere spectator. It is the shortest part of the ground. Good end to the over for the Aussies.
Play and a miss! Slower delivery outside off, Starc looks to slog it away but misses it altogether.
Good length ball on off, Agar cuts it to the point region for a single.
Mitchell Starc is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia are losing their way in the death overs. Marsh falls now! Slower one from Ngidi on off, Marsh looks to heave it away to the leg side. It takes the top edge and goes towards deep square leg. Steyn runs across, tumbles and takes the catch. The ball almost pops out but he manages to hold onto it.
WIDE! Poor bowling! Full toss down the leg side, Marsh looks to help it on its way to the fine leg fence but misses. Wide signaled.
On a length on off, Agar pushes it to the deep cover region for a single.
BEATEN! Slower delivery outside off, Agar looks to punch it to the off side but makes no connection with the ball.
Lungi Ngidi returns. 2-0-28-0 so far.
On off, Agar punches it to the deep cover for a single.
Short ball on off, Marsh punches it to deep cover for a single.
Ashton Agar is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Carey falls now and South Africa are having a really good last few overs. Full on off, Carey looks to play it over the long off region but fails to time it well. It goes way high in the air and towards long off. Faf du Plessis settles himself under it and takes a tumbling catch.
On a length outside off, Marsh cuts it to deep point for a single.

SIX! Marsh is a strong man and that has cleared the ropes with ease. Shortish delivery on off, Marsh camps back and looks to pull. He mistimes it though, getting more height than distance but eventually, the ball has enough to clear the mid-wicket fence.
WIDE! Very full delivery outside off, Marsh leaves the ball alone.
Another cutter, outside off, Marsh has a wild swing but misses.
Shortish in length on off, Carey pulls it to square leg and it is another good over for the hosts.

TWO LEG BYES! Very well bowled from Steyn! Good length ball outside off, Carey moves to the off side and looks to paddle. He misses and the ball goes off his pads to the keeper. De Kock fails to collect it cleanly and the ball rolls to third man. The batters manage to steal two leg byes.
Swing and a miss! Steyn dishes a good length ball around off, Carey dances down the track and then looks to slog it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Slower full delivery on middle, Marsh digs it out to long on for a single.
Play and a miss! Short delivery outside off, Marsh attempts to play the cut but makes no connection to it.
Slower delivery outside off, Alex moves inside his crease and cuts it to third man for a single.
Dale Steyn to bowl out. 3-0-29-2 so far.
Another one on a length on the pads, Carey makes room and then cuts it to point for a single. Good over from Phehlukwayo. 8 runs from it.
Good length delivery on off, Marsh pushes it to point and takes a single.
On a length on off, Carey punches it to the off side for a single.
Full on off, Carey drives it crisply to mid off. Miller comes across, tumbles and makes the stop.
EDGY FOUR! Luck for Carey! Short ball on middle and leg! Carey looks to pull but it takes the inside edge, hits the pads and goes over the keeper's head for a boundary. 150 up for the visitors.
Short ball on middle, Mitchell pulls it down to long on for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back on. 2-0-17-0 so far.
Good length ball on middle, Marsh flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Good over for Australia as 16 runs have come from it.

EDGY FOUR! Top edge but it's safe! Short delivery on middle, Marsh looks to pull but it takes the top edge and goes over the keeper and into the fence. The on-field umpire goes upstairs to check whether it is a maximum or a boundary. The replays suggest that it is the latter.
EDGY! On a length outside off, Carey looks to cut but it takes the outside edge and it goes to the third man region for a single.
Wide! Another one outside off, Carey lets it go. Wide signaled.
FOUR! Another one! Carey is looking good out there! Back of a length ball outside off, Carey punches it through covers to pick up the second boundary of the over.
FOUR! Cut away nicely! Short delivery outside off, Carey cuts it towards the deep point region for a boundary. The third man fielder tries giving it a chase but fails to clean it up.
Short of a length on off, Carey hops and pushes it to the point region for a dot.
WIDE! Rabada starts with a full delivery outside the off stump line, Carey leaves the ball alone. The umpire signals it a wide.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack. 1-0-11-0, his figures so far.
A short ball, around middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball, outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.

NOT OUT! What was that noise? No idea. Short and outside off, Carey backs away and looks to cut. There is a sound as he misses and de Kock jumps in joy. But the umpire does not budge. De Kock immediately signals the 'T' but Ultra Edge does not show anything. The sole review lost.

Is that a wicket? De Kock is confident but the umpire shakes his head. The keeper cum skipper immediately takes the review and then has a chat. There was a noise. But Ultra Edge detects nothing. NOTHING!

DROPPED, SIX! Great effort from Rassie van der Dussen. Full and outside off, Carey gets down and plays the slog sweep. It is not that high and pretty flat. Rassie at deep mid-wicket, waits till the eventual moment and then leaps. Gets fingertips to the ball but cannot catch it. Parries it over.
Full and outside off, Carey looks to defend but the ball spins away and beats the outside edge. Quinton de Kock whips the bails off but does not appeal.
Landed outside off, pushed straight to point.
Landed around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, this is swept through mid-wicket for a single.
Australia amidst a familiar middle order collapse. In comes Alex, to try and 'Carey' his team to a decent total.

OUT! STUMPED OFF A WIDE! Well, is the cat amongst the pigeons now? Smith is gone. The set batsman. Beautifully bowled from Shamsi. Flights this up but with pace, down the leg side. Smith is down the track and cannot get any bat on ball. Gone. End of a wonderful innings but Australia now have two new batsmen in the middle.
Short ball outside off, Smith cuts it uppishly to third man to keep strike for the next over.
Wide! Full delivery down the leg side, Smith looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it.
Mitchell Marsh is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Well, Qade is surprised and Steyn gives him a mouthful. Dale gets his second and Wade falters on his return to the T20I arena. Steyn bowls a off-cutter on off, Wade looks to heave it to the leg side but fails to get the timing he was desiring for. It goes towards deep mid-wicket where David Miller is stationed. He bends and takes a simple catch. Wade thought he had hit that well, but that was not quite the short boundary he thought he could clear easily.
Short ball on off, Wade pulls it but does not time it well. It lands safely in the deep mid-wicket region and the batters take a couple. Steyn is not happy as there was only a single on offer.
FOUR! Smashed! Short ball outside off, Wade cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Slower delivery outside off, Wade looks to play the lofted drive towards the off side but plays the shot a tad bit too early. In the end the ball lobs towards the cover region.
WIDE! Short ball down the leg side, Wade looks to play the pull but fails. Wide signaled.
Well fielded! Full delivery outside off, Smith drives it crisply towards extra cover. Phehlukwayo comes across and dives to his left to make an excellent stop. Saved three for his side.
Dale Steyn is back on. 2-0-19-1 are his figures so far.

Full on middle, Steven comes down the track and chips it over the bowler. The batsmen initially call for two but Rassie van der Dussen charges across to his right from long off. So, the batsmen settle for the single. However, Rassie fumbles and Smith is interested in the second but Wade has not seen what is happening and is not quite ready. By the time he can react, van der Dussen recovers. So the thought for the second is aborted.
Full and outside off, swept through square leg for one.
Down the leg side, spinning further away, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

Excellent stop by Kagiso Rabada. Full and outside off, Wade looks to carve this inside out but mistimes it. The ball goes in the air towards deep point but Rabada hares to his right from deep cover and dives, parrying the ball away from him. Short third man cannot quite get to it immediately and hence the batsmen take three.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, spinning in, driven back to the bowler.
On middle, Wade pushes it back to the bowler.
Shortish outside off, Smith punches it to deep cover for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Smith dances down the track and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Loopy delivery on off, Wade looks to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball goes towards the cover region and the batters take a single.

DROPPED! FOUR! South Africa give another chance to the Aussies. Pite van Biljon is the culprit. Flighted ball on off, Wade bends on his knees and looks to play the sweep. The ball takes the top edge and goes towards deep square leg. Van Biljon comes across from deep square leg but then sees Rabada running across from deep mid-wicket from the corner of his eye. Rabada though, backs off at the last moment and van Biljon has to attempt late. He has to dive and eventually, spills it. The ball rolls into the fence as well. Will Wade make the hosts pay for this miscommunication?
Smuts starts with a floated ball on off, Smith defends it to the cover region for a single.
JJ Smuts is here as the next bowling change.
Lucky again! Full and outside off, Smith looks to punch this through the covers but the ball takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps towards fine leg. A run taken.
Full and outside off, Matthew looks to push but the ball spins away and takes the outside edge, towards the fielder at short third man. The batsmen stroll across for the single.

Short and outside off, Wade goes back to punch but the ball goes off the bottom edge towards cover. The fielder fumbles at short extra and by the time Rabada gets across from sweeper, two runs are taken.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE. Down the leg side, paddle shot missed.
This is normally where Glenn Maxwell would have come to bat. Instead, it is Matthew Wade.

OUT! Great shot. Wait, CAUGHT! Well, did not see that coming. The slog from Finch against a spinner. How many times would you back that to clear the ropes? 9 out of 10. This is the rare 1 occasion. And South Africa will take it. Full and around leg, Finch backs away a touch and looks to slog it over the fence. He seems to connect well but when the ball comes down, completing its trajectory, Faf du Plessis takes it comfortably at the wide long on boundary! End of the 80-run stand.
The googly, outside off, punched through point for a single.
A short ball, outside off, pulled straight to deep mid-wicket for one. The run rate is being pushed back now.
Landed outside off, the skipper waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it towards third man for a run.
Landed outside off, AF slashes but misses.
Outside off, Aaron looks to punch but mistimes it to point.

Decent stop by Jon-Jon Smuts but surprising running from the Aussie batsmen. A short ball, around off, Smith gets across and pulls this through square leg. The ball races away but Smuts gets across and dives, half-stopping the ball. It goes a bit away from him but the batsmen take just a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
WIDE. That is a harsh call. Short and wide outside off, Finch reaches out to cut but misses. That seemed to be inside the wide guideline.
Works this down the leg side to end a 9-ball over.
Full and outside off, Steven looks for a wild slog but drags it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. Just a single.
Works this through the leg side for a run.
Full and down the leg side, Aaron looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
THIRD WIDE OF THE OVER. Again, consistency. Down the leg side, spinning down, flick shot missed. This is going to be a long over.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
ANOTHER WIDE. Short and down the leg side, flick shot missed.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Spin time to inaugurate the middle passage. Tabraiz Shamsi into the attack.
FOUR! SMASH! 70/1 IN THE POWERPLAY! Short and wide outside off, Smith slaps it over point and ends the fielding restriction period in style.
A length ball outside off, Smith looks to flick but the ball comes back in a long way and cuts him into half.
INSIDE EDGE, FOUR! Fortuitous for Smith. A length ball outside off, Smith looks to punch but the ball comes in, takes the inside edge and goes past the stumps to the fine leg fence.
Around off, Steven looks to punch it through the off side but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack. Short and outside off, Smith gets across a touch and punches it behind point.
Andile Phehlukwayo to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.

SIX! Fine way to end the over! A length ball outside off, Finch stands still this time. Lofts it as clean as a whistle and gets it all the way over long off! 50-RUN STAND IS UP! 17 from the over, 49 from the last 4!
Outside off, played through point for a couple.
FOUR! Up and over! A length ball outside off, Finch backs away and lofts it over cover. One bounce and into the ropes.
FOUR! STUPENDOUS! A short ball, outside off, Finch backs away again but this time, he pulls. Beats the man running to his left at deep square leg.
WAIT ONNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN! That is a cry of frustration from Finch. A length ball, outside off, Finch backs away and punches, but finds cover.
A length ball, around off, Smith gets across and drags this through mid-wicket for a single.
Change of ends for Lungi Ngidi. Went for 11 in his first.
A yorker to end the over, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
On a length, around middle and leg, tucked straight to short fine leg. Opportunity missed.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

EDGED, FOUR! That will not please Rabada either. A short ball, outside off, Finch looks to run it down to third man but is cramped for room. The ball takes the outside edge and flies over the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence.
Landed outside off, on a length, Smith initially looks to pull but in the end, runs it down to third man for a single.
SIX! Off the top edge. Rabada is steaming. And now, he is fuming. A short ball, around off, Smith looks to pull but the extra pace and bounce takes the top edge. The ball flies over third man!
Kagiso Rabada into the attack now.
FOUR! Cracked through point. Short and outside off, Finch stays back and punches it through point.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.

Bang! Dead ball. BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO! goes around the Bull Ring. Steyn comes charging in but loses the ball in his runup. It lands twice on the pitch but Smith charges out of his crease and smashes it over mid on. Now, the umpire signals it a dead ball but Finch is not happy. As per the rules, that should be a boundary but the umpire shakes his head. Smith says he is not sure.
FOUR! SLAUGHTERED! Short and outside off, Smith slaps it through point and gets a boundary.
A full toss, flicked through mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and outside off, punched straight to cover.
A length ball outside off, does not come off the surface. Finch looks to flick but is early into the shot. Gets a leading edge which lands on the surface.

CHANCE OF A CATCH, MISSED! FOUR! Steyn smiles. He lost it in the lights. Big moment. A short ball, outside off, Smith slashes hard towards third man. Dale Steyn comes running in for the catch but loses it in the lights. The ball goes over him and lands in front of the ropes!
Outside off, Steven looks to punch but the ball does not come off the surface. The bottom edge is induced due to the late contact and the ball rolls towards cover.
A short ball outside off, Smith plays a wild hack, but misses.

That is through as well. On a length outside off, Finch punches this through the covers. Short extra cover puts in a lazy dive to his right and misses. Faf du Plessis then gives it a chase from mid off, gets to the ball, puts in a slide at the boundary but by then, three runs are taken.
A length ball outside off, cuts back in, Aaron looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! SLAP! A perfect response to a poor ball. Short and wide outside off, Finch cuts it powerfully behind point. The ball races away.
Lungi Ngidi to bowl from the other end.
Outside off, punched straight to cover. Pacy start from Steyn.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.

INSIDE EDGE, MISSES THE STUMPS! Lucky for Finch. On a length outside off, the skipper looks to punch this through the off side, minus any footwork but luckily for his team, the addition is on the run board as the ball narrowly misses the stumps. A single to fine leg.
FOUR! Jeez, not a bad way to get off the mark. A length ball outside off, Finch gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers. The fielder dives but the ball goes past him.
Steven Smith walks in at number 3, replacing Warner.

OUT! CAUGHT! Where are you, South Africa fans? Cannot hear you, cannot hear you. Need more noise! What a brute from Steyn. A loosener first ball, back on track the next. A short ball, around middle, Warner looks to tuck it to the leg side but the ball suddenly kicks off the surface. David is caught in no man's land, unable to stop his shot and hangs his bat midway in the air. The ball lobs in the air and goes towards fine leg. Tabraiz Shamsi accepts it graciously. The crowd roars the Bull off the Bull Ring. Steyn gives a smile. Just a smile. Well, that was according to the plan, wasn't it?

FOUR! Warner is away, Australia are away but cannot say the same for the fans. There is a silence enveloping the ground, though not stunned. Not the best of balls from Steyn, banging it short and wide outside off. Warner gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers.

We are all set for the game to begin. A portion of the stands is empty, as it was damaged by a storm last night. Dale Steyn to begin the bowling storm for the match though. David Warner and Aaron Finch are the openers for Australia. Warner to face, with a slip in place. Here we go!

Australian captain, Aaron Finch, says that he too, would have looked to bowl first and observes a bit of tackiness on the wicket - but also adds that it does not matter too much in a T20I. Is looking forward to the hostile reception from the Saffa fans. Is confident about his squad, albeit ruing Glenn Maxwell's absence, but believes that the consistency in the selection in the last 2 years makes it comfortable for the players to gel around and perform better.

South African skipper, Quinton de Kock, says that inclement weather is the main reason and also, the pitch getting better to bat in the night is an added cause. On the recovery post a hectic England series, de Kock says that the team is excited to play, especially the T20 format. Is feeling great to have Rabada and du Plessis back, for all the energy.
So Pite van Biljon gets a chance owing to Temba Bavuma's absence due to injury. We learn that Heinrich Klaasen injured himself during the warm-ups, so he misses out at the last moment.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (C AND WK), Rassie van der Dussen, Faf du Plessis, JJ Smuts, David Miller, Pite van Biljon (DEBUT), Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Dale Steyn, Lungi Ngidi and Tabraiz Shamsi.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Matthew Wade, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (WK), Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson and Adam Zampa.

TOSS - Well, Faf du Plessis is back, but he has not come out for the toss. That is because he has now stepped down from captaincy, giving Quinton de Kock the reigns, with an eye for the future. And de Kock has won the flip of the coin. SOUTH AFRICA ELECT TO CHASE.

It is the Bull Ring. How can we not talk about the Bull? David Warner is back. For perhaps his last T20I series, considering that he is contemplating retirement from this format. And Steven Smith is back as well. Both these players were part of the infamous ball tampering incident a couple of years ago and without doubt, will be receiving a lot of hostility from the Protea fans.

It has not been a great day for Aussie fans, having forced to swallow the bitter pill of being defeated by India in the opening match of the 2020 Women's T20 World Cup. The defending champions suffered a shocking loss chasing 133, leaving their fans distraught. Can their male counterparts give their fans some medicine to rub on their wounds?

It is a T20I series to begin with and the first of three will be played at Jo'burg. A place where the ball flies. The same place where 434 was gunned down in an ODI by the Proteas around 14 years ago. It is the Bull Ring. Who will win the bout?

Ahoy, Aussie-Saffa fans! A team with yellow jersey plays with one wearing a yellow jersey and green trousers. Urgh... why can't it be simply yellow vs green? Anyway. South Africa had a engrossing series against England but it is this one which will matter more for them. This is where it all started 2 years ago. One of the most intense, if not the most intense rivalries in international cricket is about to resume. Hello and a warm welcome to the first international match of Australia's tour of South Africa.
